title: lowhptint
description: red outline when low, like in overwatch with customizable settings with a lot of configuration
body:
# shows a red outline when you are at X hp with X speed and X X X rgb and X opacity and X size :D
![commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a4bd9b79be8762c33928cfc2c073a00bd9e9abf.png)
![status](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ebd4192ed1751bebcde427844d9cc4635c20e70.png)
# commands

## health
1-20
default is 10(5 hearts)
## opacity
1-100
default is 100
## rgb
0 0 0
default is 255,0,0 (red) 
## size
1-300% 
default is 100%
## speed
1-10
default is 4
## status
shows output

# awesome version support
this probably supports 1.16.1-1.21.11
but im too lazy to check all those versions i only checked 1.21-1.21.11 since I only play those versions, this uses the native rendering(awesome!) thats why it supports so many versions

# history
this is how I came out and found out about this mod. cool story ig
the red outline to showcase the health was already made by other games, but in around 2016 a mod came called "potalert" by an unknown guy for version 1.7.10 later on it was ported to version 1.8.9 by [senoe](https://youtu.be/nYaTsqEGxa8?si=sDt0BBnbo4M0cH3r) in 2017

in ~2019 aycy came out with the exact same mod simply called "lowhptint" which didnt have any settings
(aycy was pretty known back then for releasing a cool mod every week)
[aycy mod archive](https://github.com/gatooooooo/aycy-mod-archive)
unfortunately he just quit out of nowhere :(
he had a yt channel but deleted most videos, unlisted some
the only thing thats left is his [hypixel forums profile](https://hypixel.net/members/aycy.1243935/)

[isXander](https://modrinth.com/user/isxander) (yes the lib guy) in 2022(nov 2021) made some settings and a simple gui for the mod and uploaded it to his website and then forgot to update his website so you couldn't download it but its okay since he gave us the source so you just had to manually compile it
